verdict.rationale: Render's own features act on many resources at once in two ways. Blueprints let you define, deploy, and version an entire multi-service architecture from a single YAML file. The CLI can view logs for multiple resources at once, which the Dashboard cannot. There is no documented general bulk-action capability (e.g., bulk redeploy, delete, or env-var updates across selected services), and the scriptable CLI and API are only building blocks. Missing for 10: explicit bulk mutate/act operations across many selected items, bulk actions exposed through the MCP server or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
